title: Cambridge research puts 31% of Ethereum node activity in the US, where a third offline can stall finalization
dc:creator: Naga Avan-Nomayo
description: Cambridge finds 31% of Ethereum node activity in the U.S., clustered on AWS, Hetzner and OVH, raising jurisdictional/counterparty questions.
